questions.prompt: How does the LMS test suite exercise the API, and why is that stronger than calling a service function directly? Cover what npm test picks up and how many tests and files that is, how the shared request() helper works step by step, which layers one request passes through, and what you must do before running it in a fresh clone.

keyPoints.text: npm test runs vitest at the root; with no vitest.config, Vitest picks up every *.test.ts.
keyPoints.quote:
With no `vitest.config` file, Vitest
picks up every `*.test.ts`

keyPoints.text: That is 23 tests in 4 files: two API files over real HTTP, plus pure policy and pure domain tests.
The request() helper calls createApp(), listens on an ephemeral port with app.listen(0), uses fetch, then closes the server.
So a request exercises login, JWT verification, route dispatch, actor construction, the service, error mapping and JSON serialization.
keyPoints.quote:
A
request therefore exercises login, JWT verification, route dispatch, actor
construction, the service, error mapping and JSON serialization

keyPoints.text: That is stronger than calling visibleAuditLogs directly.
A fresh clone has no node_modules, so npm ci must run first.
keyPoints.quote:
Running it needs `npm ci` first
(there is no `node_modules` in a fresh clone).

questions.prompt: Explain how the LMS dashboard regression test chooses its assertions for the Acme admin and the platform admin: what each asserts, why the Acme check includes a non-empty test, why explicit target ids are preferred over counts, and how test isolation is handled in audit-scope.test.ts versus api.test.ts.

keyPoints.text: For the Acme admin: auditLogs is non-empty, every row has organizationId org-acme, and version-forklift-v1 is absent.
The non-empty check matters because [].every(...) is true, so an implementation that hid all rows would otherwise pass.
keyPoints.quote:
The
  non-empty check matters because `[].every(...)` is `true` - an
  implementation that hid all rows would otherwise pass.

keyPoints.text: For the platform admin: the target ids contain both version-security-v1 and version-forklift-v1.
Explicit target ids beat counts: a count of one passes if the wrong tenant's single row comes back.
keyPoints.quote:
Explicit target ids beat counts: a count of one passes if the wrong tenant's
single row comes back.

keyPoints.text: audit-scope.test.ts uses afterEach(resetStore) to restore the shared singleton so no fixture leaks into the next test.
keyPoints.quote:
restores the shared singleton so no fixture
leaks into the next test.

keyPoints.text: api.test.ts has no such hook; its tests stay independent only because none depends on the exact contents of arrays the others append to.
keyPoints.quote:
its
tests only stay independent because none of them depends on the exact
contents of arrays the others append to.

questions.prompt: Describe the four tests in the LMS audit-scope.test.ts (what each sets up and asserts), then the "break it first" drill: what change you make to visibleAuditLogs, which tests should go red and on which assertion, which stay green, and how you restore the file.

keyPoints.text: Agreement: for the Acme admin and the platform admin, the dashboard and GET /audit-logs return the same row ids.
keyPoints.quote: the dashboard and `GET /audit-logs?page=1&pageSize=25` return the same row ids.

keyPoints.text: Filter before limit: seed one Acme row then 26 Nova rows; the Acme admin sees exactly 1 row and the platform admin exactly 25.
keyPoints.quote:
Acme admin sees exactly
   1 row; platform admin sees exactly 25.

keyPoints.text: Write path: an Acme instructor's POST /courses produces a course.created row stamped org-acme, visible to the Acme admin and excluded for a synthetic Nova admin.
Cross-tenant write refused: the same instructor naming org-nova in the body gets 403 and no course.created row for Nova.
keyPoints.quote:
the same instructor names
   `org-nova` in the body; 403 and no `course.created` row for Nova.

keyPoints.text: The drill changes visibleAuditLogs to return store.auditLogs.slice(0, 25) after the learner early return.
keyPoints.quote: `return store.auditLogs.slice(0, 25);` after the learner early return

keyPoints.text: Exactly three tests go red: the api.test.ts dashboard regression on the every(org-acme) assertion, agreement, and filter-before-limit on toHaveLength(1).
The learner assertion, write-path test and refusal test stay green; restore with git checkout -- apps/api/src/services.ts.
keyPoints.quote: The learner assertion, the write-path test and the refusal test stay green.
